title: Love it!
text: Love it!. I'm a California native and have lived in Arizona for a number of years, but I wanted a reminder of "home" so this poppy mug will do that very well!  It's a good size for my morning cold Starbucks Frappucino or my evening cocoa in the winter, and will make me smile when I see it!
